messages.subject: Occurrence error
parts:
Hi Chris,

 

I am suddenly getting an error using the same occurrence() code I’ve successfully implemented in the past. The error is stemming from the presence of two positional error estimates presence in my ctmm.fit objects. I am doing something wrong here or was there a recent change that might be causing this error?

 

Thanks for your help!

 

GUESS<-ctmm.guess(hr[[i]], interactive = FALSE, CTMM=ctmm(error=TRUE) #column HDOP present in my data

 

FIT<-ctmm.select(hr[[i]], GUESS)

 

occ.est<-occurrence(hr[[i]], CTMM=FIT)

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Occurrence error
parts:
Hi Brett,

Sorry about that. It was just a coding error that recent versions of R don't tolerate any longer. I think it should be fixed on GitHub now. If it isn't fixed, then please send me a minimal working example so that I can check for sure.

I can't tell for certain, but it looks like you are fitting errors without calibration data or a prior and have some locations with missing DOP values? Maybe the DOP values are only missing in the tracking data and not the calibration data? If the error estimates are important here, it might be worth fixing that with calibration data or a prior (covered in vignette('error') ).
By default, when DOP values are missing from certain locations, I give them their own location class (like NA-HDOP) and then assign them a very large DOP value of 100. But that doesn't seem to be sufficient here, and you probably need a prior/calibration on top of that.

Best,
Chris
